notes: Announced late May 2026 by Senate president Mircea Abrudean: USD 1 billion first-phase investment for a quantum-AI data center in Luna commune, Cluj county (bordering Mures), on 84 ha of the former 115 ha Tetarom V tech-park land concessioned 2024. PressOne investigation (29 Jun 2026) reports the site is on the banks of the Aries river near Air Base 71 Campia Turzii, the center would be built fully underground, no MoU/agreement signed, operator DriverAI LLC (Arizona, founded Jul 2024) has no prior track record, and the land concession is contested in litigation at Tribunalul Alba. mlq.ai reports a planned 80 MW capacity.
